text.p: Tropical Storm Carlo is passing about 100-150 miles north of the northern Mariana Islands and will cause squally winds and rain over the northern islands this period. Carlo will be a threat mainly to shipping as top winds increase from 60 mph to near typhoon strength by 24-48 hours. The storm will be moving northwestward and then west this period.
Heavy rain associated with the remains of T.D. Beth will continue in Vietnam for 18-24 hours more with local flooding.
Hurricane Lili, with 75 mph winds, is 555 miles east of Bermuda moving slowly to the east and is slowing down. Lili will weaken and become extratropical this period, threatening shipping only.

Rain and squalls associated with 2 tropical disturbances may affect shipping. The first is in the Arabian Sea to the west of India. The second is in the vicinity of the Andaman islands to the south of Myanmar.
